Name: Nyapu's Portraits for Seasonal Outfits - Adventurer's Guild Expanded - Color Edit
Author: SmolNublet
Description:
[size=3]This mod changes all the portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12254]Seasonal Outfits for Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url] with those from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url]. This is a continuation of my mod series to update seasonal outfit mods with color palette swaps of Nyapu's portraits.
[/size]
[size=4]Installation:[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=2][size=2]1. Download [/size][size=2]Nyapu'sP(Adventurer's Guild) from the optional files in[/size][size=2] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url][/size][size=2].
[/size][size=2]2. Replace the assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22591]Adventurer's Guild Expanded for 1.6[/url]﻿ with those from Nyapu.[/size]
3. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12254]Seasonal Outfits for Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url].
4. Manually download and unzip this mod.
5. Move the folder from this mod into your Mods folder and replace all files.
[/size]
